detail: Life 4 + Forces 3 + Prime 2 not stated together (within 700 chars) on HDYDT p.19
reason: The worked example (Jennifer as a fire-breathing tiger, p.19) names only the Forces 3/ Prime 2 fire Effect; the Life 4 comes from the rule stated earlier on the same page that a major change of your own shape, such as a full jaguar form, takes Life 4.
